projects.name: PANGAEA
projects.description: A modern, open-source playground for generating, previewing, and applying UI code via OpenRouter. Built on Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, it streams AI-generated snippets into a live, sandboxed preview.

projects.name: OurMovieList
projects.description: OurMovieList is a dynamic and interactive web application designed to enhance how friends and groups discover, manage, and share their favorite movies. This platform offers a seamless experience for tracking trending films, creating and managing private groups, and building shared watchlists, fostering a collaborative movie-watching journey.

projects.name: Memecoin Tracker
projects.description: CandleView is a MacOS Native app that allows you track Memecoins from a Contract Address on the Solana Network. CandleView then displays the price action of the coin in a simple candlestick chart, allowing you to quickly glance at how the coin is performing, all within an overlay window - so it's always visible. No matter what is in the background

projects.name: OzBargain - Raycast Extension
projects.tagline: Latest OzBargain deals powered by Raycast
projects.description: Raycast is a powerful launcher and productivity tool, with an api that allows developers to publish extensions onto their store platform. This allows anyone and everyone using Raycast to download whatever extensions will make them more productive. The OzBargain Deals Raycast Extension allows users to see and explore the latest deals posted on OzBargain through Raycast — eliminating the friction of checking the platform multiple times a day.
